clip.prompt: Create a 10-second standalone meditation-app ambient scene using text-to-video: slow waves at sunset on an empty beach, in vertical 9:16. Naturalistic cinematic footage with soft amber sunset light, a peaceful mood, fine wet-sand texture, and delicate sea foam; the movement is slow, gentle, and unhurried. Use one continuous shot with the same empty shoreline, low horizon, and sunset lighting throughout; no people or buildings are shown. From 0–5 seconds, frame a wide shoreline view with wet sand in the lower half and the small setting sun near the upper-third horizon; a shallow wave marked by a thin white foam edge washes toward the foreground, with warm sky reflected on the sand, as the camera drifts very slowly sideways parallel to the waterline. From 5–10 seconds, retain the wide framing and the shoreline’s thin white foam edge as the wave gently recedes, revealing smooth reflective sand; continue the same subtle sideways camera drift, easing to a complete stop by second 8. Sound is only natural, softly rolling surf and the faint hiss of retreating water, at an even, soothing level; no music, voices, or words. For the final two seconds, hold the camera completely still on the clear, tranquil composition while the water continues its barely perceptible natural movement. Use a restrained warm grade, natural blues in the water, soft highlight roll-off, and slow, uninterrupted pacing. Negatives: no cuts, text, subtitles, logos, people, animals, boats, buildings, litter, dramatic waves, fast motion, camera shake, exaggerated saturation, music, or speech.
